/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
sandbox=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='www-boxbox-68-pilot-'))
box=sandbox/'.boxbox'
box.mkdir()
def load(name):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in (root/'.boxbox'/f'{name}.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line]
key='v1|typescript|InterfaceDeclaration|interface-members|colon>semicolon'
scope='src/native-reports.ts'
convention=next(r for r in load('conventions') if r['key']==key and r['scope']==scope)
decision=next(r for r in load('decisions') if r['id']==convention['id'])
examples=[r for r in load('examples') if r['id'] in convention['examples']]
for name,rows in [('conventions',[convention]),('decisions',[decision]),('examples',examples)]:
    (box/f'{name}.jsonl').write_text(''.join(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n' for r in rows))
ref=decision['ref'].split('#')[0]
p=sandbox/ref
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
shutil.copyfile(root/ref,p)
target
